# ACT NOW — recalled stock is on our shelves

**fda:H-1351-2026** · Taylor Fresh Foods Inc · 2026-08-07

> Spicy Guacamole. Ingredients: Guacamole, Pico De Gallo. Spec Sheet: Guacamole (Avocado, Pico De Gallo, Serrano Peper…

## Why
The FDA recall notice from Taylor Fresh Foods Inc. identifies Spicy Guacamole with UPC 030223073574 due to potential Salmonella contamination and lists specific lot codes TFTN2171, TFTX211, TFTX213, TFTX215U11, and TFTX216U11 [E1][E2][E3][E6][E7]. Our inventory matches this UPC and holds those exact lots [E9][E10]. We currently have 122 units on hand across 6 stores and have sold 154 units to 96 loyalty customers since the recall date of 2026-08-07 [E11][E12][E13][E14].

## What we matched
- `NW-100094` Spicy guacamole — **same** (rule, upc): our UPC 030223073574 is printed in the notice
- `NW-100195` Mango Pico De Gallo — **not-this** (judge, text): notice is about "Spicy Guacamole"

## Actions
- Pull lots TFTN2171, TFTX211, TFTX213, TFTX215U11, TFTX216U11 from 6 store(s): S007 (39), S017 (36), S008 (19), S005 (15), S022 (7), S010 (6) [E12]
- Send recall notice to loyalty customers who bought affected lots since 2026-08-07: at most 96 [E14]
- Contact Supplier S015 (synthetic) for credit and replacement [E15]

## Caveats
- Retailer stock, sales, lots and ship notices are synthetic (Northwind Mercantile, generated for this demo); food items are real products with real barcodes (USDA FoodData Central, Open Food Facts).
- Stores in NJ, WA hold stock although the notice's distribution list does not name those states — product can travel through distributors, so this is not a clearance.
- Customer count sums weekly distinct counts, so it is an upper bound.

## Evidence
